title: Bitcoin dips below $70,000 as selloff gathers pace
summary: The crypto market selloff gathered pace early Friday. Bitcoin dropped below $70,000 and ether traded below $2,000, triggering large liquidations in futures market.

title: North Korea's Binance hack faces U.S. crackdown as DOJ targets $1.2 billion in stolen crypto
summary: Federal authorities say they've taken infrastructure used in the FaceStealer scheme used to steal as much as $400 million in crypto assets.

title: U.S. President Trump names CFTC, SEC nominees for first time in a year
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has named two potential commissioners each to the Securities and Exchange Commission and Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr.’s advisory contract over 1789 Capital’s Polymarket investment
summary: Trump Jr. joined Kalshi as a strategic adviser in January 2025, helping the prediction market expand its customer base and strengthen its market presence.

title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
summary: The legal battle to head off the crypto transaction tax in Illinois has drawn up a hefty roster of industry opposition, and they're saying the tax won't work.
